theme.title: Themes
theme.body: Choose the colour scheme used across SafeCircle

theme_schedule.title: Match system settings
theme_schedule.body: Follow your device and switch between a day and a night theme

theme_day.title: Day
theme_day.body: When your system reports light theme

theme_night.title: Night
theme_night.body: When your system reports dark theme

solarium.title: Enable solarium glass effects
solarium.body: Apply a see-through glassy material to many surfaces

noise.title: Noise overlay opacity
noise.body: Apply a coat of subtle noise to add variation to solid backgrounds

sat_bg.title: Card background vibrancy
sat_bg.body: Bring some colour into your world (or reduce it)

accent_type.title: Presets
accent_type.body: Follow the season, use your avatar, or pick a colour of your own

sat.title: Vibrancy
sat.body: How rich or muted the accent looks

font_choice.title: Interface font
font_choice.body: Choose the typeface used across SafeCircle

font.title: Font choice
font.body: Type the name of a font installed on your device

font_serif.title: Use old-fashioned Serif font for some headings
font_serif.body: Adds an italic serif to hero and section titles

font_weight_medium.title: Medium font weight
font_weight_medium.body: Used for button text and small headers

grid_glow.title: Reflect colour below cards and avatars
grid_glow.body: Applies a glow below cards based on the primary colour

avatar_radius.title: Profile avatar shape
avatar_radius.body: Applies to every avatar, only visible to you

time_format.title: Time format
time_format.body: Choose how times are shown across the dashboard

relative_times.title: Show relative times
relative_times.body: Show "3 minutes ago" instead of exact dates; hover to see the full date

compact.title: Compact mode
compact.body: Tighter rows and spacing so more fits on screen

start_page.title: Start page
start_page.body: The page SafeCircle opens when you visit the dashboard

carousel_mode.title: Overview carousel
carousel_mode.body: What the cover-flow on the Overview page shows

alert_toasts.title: Show alert toasts
alert_toasts.body: Pop up a notification the moment a new alert arrives

seasonal.title: Automatically adapt to seasonal events
seasonal.body: Adapts the default colour and shows particles depending on the season

seasonal_particles.title: Show particles during select seasons
seasonal_particles.body: Falling snow and other ambient effects

seasonal_particles_lite.title: Reduce quality of particles
seasonal_particles_lite.body: Drops the glow around particles to ease the load on slower devices

seasonal_overlays.title: Display additional seasonal effects
seasonal_overlays.body: Cobwebs, frost and other decorations on cards

reduced_motion.title: Reduce motion in animations
reduced_motion.body: Decreases the intensity of animations, hover effects, and other moving parts

show_scroller.title: Show page scrollbar
show_scroller.body: Scrollbars are hidden by default; turn this on to bring the page scrollbar back

underline_links.title: Always underline links
underline_links.body: Forces buttons, links, and other interactables to have an underline

update_auto_check.title: Check for updates automatically
update_auto_check.body: Look for a new version of SafeCircle in the background

play_beta.title: Google Play beta updates
play_beta.body: Get early builds of the SafeCircle Android app from Google Play

developer.title: Developer mode
developer.body: Shows debug details and internal setting ids
